description:
## Problem
Template keep/adjust decisions rest on single sequential CLI cells and an ad hoc script in /tmp. Two TPC-H runs of the same comparison disagreed (1.24× and 0.80×). Q11, which touches no tuned table, moved 0.72×, so per-query noise is about 30%. Rows read did not predict time. Nobody can tell a real benefit from noise, and failed queries silently drop out of the geometric mean.

## Prior art (extend)
- `/tmp/tpch-tuned-regression-tools-20261007/layout_study.py` (`build SRC_DB TAG LAYOUT...`, `run TAG QUERY_DIR ROUNDS LAYOUT[@pack]... --out F`, `report F`). It loads once and times shuffled, interleaved rounds, varies layout and session pack separately, and records rows read. It lives in /tmp and may be deleted: copy it into the repository first.
- Memory rungs: `docs/operations/uat-framework.md`.
- Settle logic: `benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/merge_settle.py` (`MergeSettleResult`).

## Requirements
1. Inputs: platform, benchmark, scale factor, arms (notuning, tuned, named variants such as layout-only or pack-only), rounds and seed.
2. Load each arm once, on a fresh database or container per benchmark. Record load time and settle time per arm, separately from query time.
3. Run the settle hook for every arm, notuning included, before any timed query, so all arms are timed on settled data. Record a settle timeout as unsettled for that arm.
4. Time queries in shuffled order, interleaved across arms, with a stated minimum number of rounds (at least 7).
5. A/A mode: run the same configuration as two arms and report per-query and geometric-mean noise. Rule thresholds come from this.
6. Statistics: per-query medians; geometric mean of per-query ratios; total elapsed time; bootstrap confidence intervals for the geometric-mean ratio and for each query.
7. Failures: a query that fails in any arm is reported by name. Report the geometric mean both over the common passing set and with a stated failure penalty (for example, the timeout). Never drop a failure silently.
8. Correctness: compare each arm's row counts (and result checksums where available) with notuning. A mismatch fails the comparison.
9. Environment guards: skip and retry a round when the host load average exceeds a ceiling (default 8, configurable). Record engine version, container memory, host and harness version. State the cache policy: warm by default, with an optional cold mode.
10. Diagnostics where the engine exposes them: rows read and peak memory per query (ClickHouse `system.query_log`).
11. Platform seams: connection, settle hook and an optional cost reader per platform. Implement ClickHouse (server and chDB) and DuckDB here; the settle default is a no-op. Keep the seam narrow enough that `cloud-tuned-benefit-measurement-20261008` can add Databricks and Snowflake without restructuring.
12. Optional throughput mode (N concurrent streams) for templates near the memory envelope.
13. Output: one JSON file with all raw timings and environment, plus a markdown summary.

## Decision gate
- Location: internal development tooling only (for example under `scripts/`), not a CLI command and not part of the package. Check AGENTS.md and the UAT production-LOC ceiling gate first. If the harness needs so much of `benchbox` internals that a CLI subcommand looks better, stop and ask the owner.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- The harness reports. It does not hard-code pass/fail thresholds; `tuning-evidence-benefit-rule-20261008` owns those.
- This item implements and runs local engines only (ClickHouse server in a container, chDB, DuckDB). No cloud runs from this item.
- Never write to published results or bundles.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`. Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit owner approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop 5ca12e6ca.
